name: FlexBench
description: A self-evolving framework that automatically constructs specialized instruction-following benchmarks from a single instruction, enabling customized, fine-grained, and reproducible evaluation of LLM instruction following. It includes FlexEval, which aggregates multi-dimensional judgments into instruction-level metrics capturing workflow progress and conditional correctness.
reputation: A new benchmark proposed in recent work; it is not yet broadly adopted as a community standard but is positioned as a flexible framework for instruction-following evaluation.
notes: Enables instruction-specialized evaluations that adapt to arbitrary tasks; validated on 248 complex instructions and multiple LLMs.
